text_block_list.text:
After winning numerous races with Super Creek,
she began receiving all sorts of offers.

Magazine interviews, commercials, TV appearances...
For a while, days were spent dealing with endless requests, but—
choice_data_list: Finally got a moment to breathe, huh
We've finally caught a break, haven't we

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Now you can rest easy for a while~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: That's right!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Since we have this great opportunity, why not go to a hot spring?
We could use the travel voucher from the lottery...

Those words reminded me of the promise
we made to go on a hot springs trip together
once things settled down.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"We're on break starting tomorrow,
so don't you think it's a great opportunity~?"

And so, the next day, I headed off to the hot spring inn
together with Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: My, my, what a charming and tasteful inn~.
choice_data_list: Apparently it's a famous inn that's even been featured in magazines!
I heard it's a famous inn that's even featured in magazines.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to that♪
Well then, shall we go?

With hearts full of anticipation,
the two of us passed through the inn's gates.
And—
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Phew.
That was a lovely bath♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Your skin is looking so radiant and refreshed too, Trainer~.
choice_data_list: Yeah, all my fatigue from work just blew away.
Yeah, all my fatigue from work just blew right away.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: That's great to hear~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Shall we head straight to your room then,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Since it's a hot spring trip, please relax and heal to your heart's content~♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Here, say aah♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You have quite an appetite♪
Next up, please enjoy some wild vegetable tempura~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything else you'd like to eat,
just let me know♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Your shoulders have completely relaxed, haven't they?
Now, let's move on to your arms and hands—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Rub, squeeze... and relax♪
Let's massage all the way to the fingertips~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
After the massage, let's clean your ears...
Come on, rest your head on my lap♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Does it feel good, Trainer?

And just like that,
I ended up being thoroughly spoiled...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*...
I'm so glad we came on this hot springs trip~♪
choice_data_list: Why don't you get some rest too, Creek?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm getting plenty of rest~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Spoiling you is how I unwind, Trainerâª

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Besides, these headpats
are to say thank you~

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
During the Arima Kinen, and even before then,
you've always walked right beside me—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-san♪
...is what I wanted to express.
choice_data_list: If that's the case, go all out!
If that's the case, give it everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Starting tomorrow, our days of walking together
will begin anew, but—"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Please let me pamper you
like this every now and then~

It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond with Super Creek...
